info.title: E-Commerce Platform API
info.description: Store APIs are served on the store host and admin APIs on the admin host (`*.localhost` locally). Mutating requests need a same-origin `Origin` header. Sessions are httpOnly cookies set by the sign-in endpoints. Generated by `npm run docs:openapi` from the route handlers.

servers.description: This host: admin APIs on the admin host, store APIs on the store host

ValidationFailed.description: The request did not pass validation (fieldErrors in details)

PermissionDenied.description: Signed in, but the role lacks the required permission

RateLimited.description: Too many requests; retry after the Retry-After header
